sessionToken.title: Session Token (optional — paste coulomb_sess cookie to bypass login)
sessionToken.description: If login is blocked by bot-protection: log into driver.chargepoint.com in your browser, open DevTools → Application → Cookies → https://driver.chargepoint.com, copy the value of the coulomb_sess cookie, and paste it here.

matter.title: Show in the Apple Home Energy view (via Matter)
matter.description: Also publish the charger over Matter as a standalone electrical sensor, so live watts and energy feed the Apple Home Energy view without a second accessory tile. Requires Homebridge 2.3.0+ with Matter enabled on this plugin's child bridge; skipped safely otherwise.

evePowerUpdates.title: Eve power/energy updates

oneOf.title: Throttled — push significant changes, plus every 5 minutes (recommended)
Poll only — never push; lowest traffic, breaks automations triggered by these values

evePowerUpdates.description: How often the Eve Current Consumption, Total Consumption, Voltage and Electric Current values are pushed to HomeKit. Eve and Home+ automations can trigger on or check these values; only choose Poll only if none of yours do. The On and Outlet In Use switches always update immediately.

minChangeWatts.title: Throttled: minimum power change (W)
minChangeWatts.description: Push a power change when it is at least this many watts or the percentage below, whichever is larger.

minChangeKwh.title: Throttled: minimum energy change (kWh)
minChangeKwh.description: Push a Total Consumption change when it is at least this many kWh.
